name: ai-dev-factory
description: A software developer factory: Claude agents work tickets, you run the floor as PM.
author: Kris Cagle

scripts.setup: env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm install --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ && npm run build && npm start
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
